# Design notes (v0.1, early beta)

## Records (all generated by `src/plugin/BountiesOfOblivion.Generator`)

| EditorID | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `BOO_LedgerQuest` | Quest (start game enabled) | Runs `BOO_LedgerScript`: Ledger delivery, menus, contract dispatch, pay, favor, rivalries, blessings and gifts. |
| `BOO_Contract<Prince>` (8) | Quest, type Daedric | One radiant task per prince, all running `BOO_ContractScript`. Alias layout: 0 `ContractLocation`, 1 `MapMarker`, 2 `Target` / `RelicContainer`, 3 `Relic`. |
| `BOO_Bound`, `BOO_ContractActive`, `BOO_ContractsDone`, `BOO_RevelCount` | Globals | State. `BOO_Bound` is 1 after signing, -1 if the Ledger was cast away. |
| `BOO_Favor<Prince>` (8) | Globals | Favor, 0 to 100. |
| `BOO_IntroMinLevel` (5), `BOO_PayMult` (1.0), `BOO_FavorGain` (20), `BOO_RivalLoss` (10) | Globals | Tunables. |
| `BOO_PowerLedger` + `BOO_LedgerEffect` | Lesser power + script effect | Opens the Ledger. |
| `BOO_Ledger` | Book with an `OnRead` script | Offers the pact the first time, opens the menu afterwards. |
| `BOO_Blessing<Prince>` (8) | Abilities | Built on vanilla `Ab*` magic effects. |
| `BOO_Boon<Prince>` + `BOO_EnchBoon<Prince>` (8 each) | Armor (jewelry) + enchantment | Vanilla ring/amulet meshes and armor addons, vanilla `Ench*ConstantSelf` effects, `MagicDisallowEnchanting`. |
| `BOO_GildedWager`, `BOO_NightmareShard` | Misc items | Relics for Clavicus Vile and Vaermina (vanilla gyro and amethyst meshes). |
| `BOO_RevelWine` + `BOO_RevelWineEffect` | Ingestible + script effect | Each drink reports to the Ledger. |
| `BOO_Champion01..03` + `BOO_LCharChampion` | NPCs templated on `LCharBanditBoss` (everything but name) | Boethiah's champions. |
| `BOO_Quarry01..04` + `BOO_LCharQuarry` | NPCs templated on `LCharBearAll` / `LCharSabrecat` | Hircine's quarry. |
| `BOO_Msg*` | Messages | Menus and offers. Payouts and standings use `Debug.MessageBox` so prince names can be built in script. |

## Contracts

| Prince | Location alias (inside `CompanionsRadiantAllowedHolds`) | Goal | Script type |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mehrunes Dagon | `LocTypeBanditCamp` OR `LocTypeForswornCamp`, has a Boss ref, not cleared | Boss dies | 0 kill |
| Boethiah | `LocTypeDungeon` with a map marker, cleared allowed | Created champion dies | 0 kill |
| Namira | `LocTypeDraugrCrypt`, has a Boss ref, not cleared | Boss dies or location cleared | 1 clear |
| Molag Bal | `LocTypeVampireLair`, has a Boss ref, not cleared | Boss dies | 0 kill |
| Clavicus Vile | `LocTypeDwarvenAutomatons` with a boss container, cleared allowed | Player holds the relic (created in the boss container) | 2 fetch |
| Hircine | `LocTypeAnimalDen` OR `LocTypeGiantCamp` with a map marker, cleared allowed | Created quarry dies | 0 kill |
| Sanguine | `LocTypeInn`, optional `LocationCenterMarker` for the quest marker | 3 Revel Wines drunk inside the location | 3 revel |
| Vaermina | `LocTypeWarlockLair` OR `LocTypeHagravenNest` with a boss container, cleared allowed | Player holds the relic | 2 fetch |

All location aliases use *Reserves location*, so other radiant quests (vanilla, Blackshield Company, others) won't pick the same location while a task is active, and the reverse.

## Flow

1. `BOO_LedgerScript` registers for sleep and polls every 60 s. Once the player is level ≥ `BOO_IntroMinLevel`, out of combat, has controls, and MQ101 (Helgen) isn't running, the Ledger is delivered on the next wake-up, or after one in-game day of eligibility.
2. Reading the Ledger offers *Sign / Not now / Cast it away*. Signing adds the power. If the unsigned Ledger is lost, it comes back on the next wake-up.
3. Accepting a task calls `Stop/Reset/Start` on the prince's quest. If the engine can't fill the aliases, the player sees "The page stays blank…".
4. `BOO_ContractScript` polls every 4 s (kill/clear/fetch) or reacts to Revel Wine drinks. On success it calls `BOO_LedgerScript.ContractCompleted(prince)`.
5. Payout: `floor((150 + 10 × level) × BOO_PayMult)` gold, `+BOO_FavorGain` favor, `-BOO_RivalLoss` with the rival (clamped to 0–100). Then blessings and gifts are re-evaluated for both princes.

## Text

Papyrus string literals never contain backslash escapes (the build compiler and the game do not expand them). Line breaks come from `BOO_LedgerScript.LineBreak`, a string property holding one real LF that the generator fills; `Br()` falls back to a space when it is empty (a pre-0.1.3 save). `check_string_escapes.py` and the plugin validator fail the build on a literal backslash escape.
